00300 /* Relocate STACK from its old location to the new one.  The
00301    local variables YYSIZE and YYSTACKSIZE give the old and new number of
00302    elements in the stack, and YYPTR gives the new location of the

00304    stack.  */

00306     do                                                                  \

00309         YYCOPY (&yyptr->Stack, Stack, yysize);                          \

00311         yynewbytes = yystacksize * sizeof (*Stack) + YYSTACK_GAP_MAXIMUM; \
00312         yyptr += yynewbytes / sizeof (*yyptr);                          \
00313       }                                                                 \
00314     while (YYID (0))

00793 # ifndef yytnamerr
00794 /* Copy to YYRES the contents of YYSTR after stripping away unnecessary
00795    quotes and backslashes, so that it's suitable for yyerror.  The
00796    heuristic is that double-quoting is unnecessary unless the string
00797    contains an apostrophe, a comma, or backslash (other than
00798    backslash-backslash).  YYSTR is taken from yytname.  If YYRES is
00799    null, do not copy; instead, return the length of what the result
00800    would have been.  */
00801 static YYSIZE_T
00802 yytnamerr (char *yyres, const char *yystr)
00803 {
00804   if (*yystr == '"')
00805     {
00806       YYSIZE_T yyn = 0;
00807       char const *yyp = yystr;
00808 
00809       for (;;)
00810         switch (*++yyp)
00811           {
00812           case '\'':
00813           case ',':
00814             goto do_not_strip_quotes;
00815 
00816           case '\\':
00817             if (*++yyp != '\\')
00818               goto do_not_strip_quotes;
00819             /* Fall through.  */
00820           default:
00821             if (yyres)
00822               yyres[yyn] = *yyp;
00823             yyn++;
00824             break;
00825 
00826           case '"':
00827             if (yyres)
00828               yyres[yyn] = '\0';
00829             return yyn;
00830           }
00831     do_not_strip_quotes: ;
00832     }
00833 
00834   if (! yyres)
00835     return yystrlen (yystr);
00836 
00837   return yystpcpy (yyres, yystr) - yyres;
00838 }

00841 /* Copy into YYRESULT an error message about the unexpected token

00866 # if 0

00871       YY_("syntax error, unexpected %s, expecting %s or %s");
00872       YY_("syntax error, unexpected %s, expecting %s or %s or %s");
00873       YY_("syntax error, unexpected %s, expecting %s or %s or %s or %s");

00876       char const *yyf;
00877       static char const yyunexpected[] = "syntax error, unexpected %s";
00878       static char const yyexpecting[] = ", expecting %s";
00879       static char const yyor[] = " or %s";

00881                     + sizeof yyexpecting - 1
00882                     + ((YYERROR_VERBOSE_ARGS_MAXIMUM - 2)

00901             if (yycount == YYERROR_VERBOSE_ARGS_MAXIMUM)

00904                 yysize = yysize0;
00905                 yyformat[sizeof yyunexpected - 1] = '\0';
00906                 break;
00907               }
00908             yyarg[yycount++] = yytname[yyx];
00909             yysize1 = yysize + yytnamerr (0, yytname[yyx]);
00910             yysize_overflow |= (yysize1 < yysize);
00911             yysize = yysize1;
00912             yyfmt = yystpcpy (yyfmt, yyprefix);

00933               if (*yyp == '%' && yyf[1] == 's' && yyi < yycount)
